mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may increase norethindrone metabolism via CYP450 enzyme inhibition, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy, while norethindrone may potentiate MAOI effects through estrogen-related serotonergic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use alternative contraception; if combination necessary, monitor for breakthrough bleeding and MAOI efficacy; counsel on increased pregnancy risk.
